purpose: Implement and falsify the complete EXP-G1 family boundary, least-privilege stage graph, nested selection, deterministic reductions, paired scorer, accounting, cleanup, and terminal publication on synthetic data before any official development input or execution claim exists.
hypothesis: A small family-bearing fixture plus a deterministic full-topology model double and a bounded real-CatBoost compatibility probe can expose implementation drift in the frozen 8,820-fit EXP-G1 design without using synthetic performance to select science.
targeted_failure: The G2-3A contract is not executable evidence: family leakage, outer-truth selection, seed/configuration omission, receipt forgery, nondeterministic reduction, or incomplete terminal cleanup could survive static review unless the exact control flow is replayed adversarially.
occam_boundary: Use one additive runner, one additive synthetic driver, and focused tests. Replay the exact scientific topology with a deterministic model double and use real CatBoost only to prove the twelve frozen constructor forms and three seed values resolve in the locked runtime. Do not spend 17,640 real fits on synthetic outcomes that have no scientific meaning.
targeted_failure_modes: V1/V2 molecule, duplicate, or component leakage across outer or inner boundaries
V3 inner selection influenced by outer truth, baseline predictions, or later diagnostics
V4 configuration, model-seed, feature-order, runtime, or resolved-parameter drift
V6 synthetic or tutorial diagnostics mislabeled as official challenge evidence
C6 altered MapLight representation or CatBoost constructor semantics
P5 partial fit sets, cross-root identity forgery, nondeterminism, retry, resume, overwrite, or budget reuse
P6 official, confirmatory, historical-row, blinded-test, TDI, external, submission, metric, leaderboard, or upload contamination

implementation_scope.dependency_rule: Use the existing locked research runtime and Python standard library. Add no dependency, package abstraction, service, workflow engine, or production API.
implementation_scope.hash_binding: The acceptance receipt must bind this contract and every implementation, reused-source, lockfile, and test source byte. G2-3C must bind only the reviewed integrated hashes accepted by two fresh replays.

synthetic_fixture.root_b_order: exact reverse physical row order before trusted compilation
synthetic_fixture.feature_shape_rule: Publish deterministic finite float32 arrays in the exact accepted 1,024 Morgan-count, 1,024 Avalon-count, 315 ErG, and 200 descriptor column order. Include the accepted descriptor NaN pattern only where the fixture manifest declares it.
synthetic_fixture.family_rule: Both molecules in a component share every outer and scoped inner assignment. Every outer fold and every scoped inner fold contains at least one multi-molecule component in training and validation, and no component crosses either boundary.
synthetic_fixture.truth_rule: Deterministic finite point/lower/upper values cover every endpoint and fold; selected missing rows exercise the immutable mask while retaining positive finite tutorial denominators in every selector and outer scoring population.
synthetic_fixture.selection_oracles: Fixture metadata predeclares inner-only expected selections containing at least three different configuration IDs across the 60 outer endpoint cells, at least one exact metric tie resolved by configuration_id, and a future endpoint configuration token. Oracle values are mechanics assertions only.
synthetic_fixture.physical_order_invariance: Compilation canonicalizes authenticated bytes by explicit identity keys. The two roots must publish byte-identical relative terminal maps despite opposite physical source order.

stage_graph.trusted_compiler: Authenticate the synthetic source and parent contract before parsing, validate the label-free family folds before truth parse, and publish immutable disjoint per-cell capabilities plus sealed scorer truth.
stage_graph.inner_model: May read one inner-training target capability, exact matching train/predict features, one configuration token, and one model seed. It cannot resolve validation truth, outer truth, baseline predictions, selector outputs from another cell, or scorer paths.
stage_graph.inner_freezer: Requires exactly three prediction sets for one configuration and cell, validates full identity and lineage, then averages in ascending seed order with math.fsum divided by three. It reads no truth.
stage_graph.inner_selector: Opens pooled inner-validation truth only after all twelve configuration freezers for one outer endpoint cell are immutable. It ranks tutorial ST-RAE, component-macro MAE, then configuration_id and cannot resolve outer-validation truth.
stage_graph.outer_model: May read only the selected configuration token, one seed, matching outer-training target capability, and train/predict features. It cannot resolve outer truth, inner truth, fixed-baseline predictions, or metric outputs.
stage_graph.outer_freezer: Requires exactly three selected-seed predictions with identical selection lineage and averages in ascending seed order with math.fsum divided by three before any outer truth opens.
stage_graph.outer_scorer: Only after all 60 candidate outer cell freezers are immutable, opens paired synthetic outer truth and synthetic baseline predictions on exact identities and publishes aggregate-only diagnostics.
stage_graph.global_configuration_freezer: After the outer result is terminal, derives one future synthetic configuration token per endpoint only from the complete selection projection and cannot revise any outer prediction.
stage_graph.terminal_publisher: Publishes once with no-replace semantics, complete receipts, exact accounting, authority, cleanup status, and either one success/rejection terminal or one fail-closed terminal.

full_topology_model_double.purpose: Exercise every configuration-seed-cell identity, freezer, selector, projection, scorer, terminal, and exact counter cheaply; it is not a CatBoost surrogate and yields no scientific evidence.
full_topology_model_double.determinism: Prediction is a pure documented float64 function of authenticated fixture features and the exact repeat, outer fold, inner fold or outer stage, endpoint, configuration_id, model_seed, molecule_id, and component receipt. No truth, metric, wall clock, process ID, filesystem order, random device, or mutable state may enter it.
full_topology_model_double.catboost_fit_accounting: Model-double invocations must be named and counted separately and never reported as CatBoost fits.

locked_runtime_catboost_probe.purpose: Prove every frozen constructor form and all three seed values can fit, predict finite values, and expose a canonical resolved-parameter receipt in Python 3.10.13, NumPy 1.25.2, and CatBoost 1.2.1.
per_root: fit each of G1-C00 through G1-C11 once under seed 20260824
locked_runtime_catboost_probe.input: Use an authenticated family-disjoint subset of the exact 2,563-column synthetic fixture with finite targets and a fixed prediction set. Preserve each configuration's exact iterations and arguments; no fast-mode parameter substitution is allowed.
locked_runtime_catboost_probe.acceptance: All fits complete, all predictions are finite, constructor arguments match G2-3A exactly, canonical resolved-parameter receipts match between roots for each probe identity, and the three G1-C00 seed receipts preserve the exact distinct random_seed values.
locked_runtime_catboost_probe.scientific_boundary: The probe neither ranks configurations nor enters selection, outer evidence, promotion gates, or any scientific comparison.

deterministic_numeric_policy.canonical_order: Sort every reduction by the complete contracted identity tuple, never physical input or process completion order.
deterministic_numeric_policy.seed_mean: math.fsum in ascending seed order divided by exactly three
deterministic_numeric_policy.outer_context_mean: math.fsum in ascending outer-fold order divided by exactly four
deterministic_numeric_policy.endpoint_macro: math.fsum in canonical endpoint order divided by exactly four
deterministic_numeric_policy.repeat_mean: math.fsum in ascending repeat order divided by exactly three
deterministic_numeric_policy.bootstrap: Use the exact G2-3A unit, seed, accepted replicate count, maximum attempts, rejection rule, and interpolated quantiles.
deterministic_numeric_policy.failure: Any missing, duplicate, extra, cross-cell, nonfinite, identity-mismatched, receipt-mismatched, or noncanonically reducible row fails the whole replay.

required_adversarial_tests: two fresh roots with reversed physical source order publish byte-identical relative terminal maps
a molecule or component crossing an outer boundary fails before any model-stage invocation
a molecule or component crossing a scoped inner boundary fails before any model-stage invocation
inner model access to validation truth and outer model access to outer truth both fail
inner selector access to outer truth or selection from outer diagnostics fails
wrong configuration, missing seed, duplicate seed, extra seed, and configuration-seed identity forgery fail
prediction omission, duplication, extra row, cross-cell row, cross-root mix, and forged lineage fail
wrong feature order, feature count, runtime, constructor, or resolved parameter fails
nonfinite prediction, truth, score, bootstrap value, or nonpositive tutorial denominator fails
partial model-double topology and any real-probe count other than exactly fourteen per root fail
physical process completion order cannot change seed, projection, macro, repeat, or bootstrap bytes
retry, resume, moved attempt, overwrite, second publication, symlink, traversal, and writable accepted root fail
interrupt and injected stage failure publish no success terminal and leave no reusable capability or partial destination
all official and forbidden-operation counters remain exactly zero

acceptance.scientific_interpretation: Acceptance proves synthetic mechanics and locked-runtime compatibility only. No synthetic score, selection, prediction, or CatBoost probe result may support a model claim.

terminal_contract.publication: The tracked acceptance may contain aggregate synthetic counts, expected selections, receipts, timings, resource use, authority, and decisions only. Full synthetic row outputs stay in disposable replay roots.
terminal_contract.immutability: A replay root publishes at most once. An interrupted or failed root is destroyed after its aggregate blocker is recorded and cannot be resumed, repaired, moved, or reclassified as accepted.

resource_ceiling.rule: Run the two roots sequentially. Exceeding any ceiling fails G2-3B and grants no repair or official authority.
